prompt: Find every company, person and city mentioned in thousands of news articles.
tells: every company, person and city mentioned
why: Named entity recognition labels people, organizations and places.
trap: These aren't being hidden, so it's not PII detection.

prompt: Extract the dates and money amounts mentioned in free-text customer emails.
why: Dates and quantities are entity categories in Azure Language NER.
trap: Document extraction targets forms and documents with known fields; these are free-text emails.

prompt: Label medications, dosages and symptoms in doctors' free-text notes.
why: Labeling categories of things in text is entity recognition (there's a health-specific version).
trap: The goal is labeling, not hiding.

prompt: When an article mentions 'Mercury', the app must tell whether it means the planet or the element and link the right encyclopedia page.
why: Entity linking resolves which real thing an entity refers to.
trap: Embeddings measure similarity; entity linking picks the specific referent.
